usageNotes: Use this to update an existing SDN IPAM object's configuration (URL, API token, TLS fingerprint, etc.) without recreating it. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/ipams. Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent edits; omit fields you are not changing and use the 'delete' param to explicitly remove optional settings.

examples.summary: Update a phpIPAM integration's URL and API token

tips: The endpoint returns null on success; confirm the update by reading the object with get_cluster_sdn_ipams_ipam.
Use the 'delete' param (comma-separated config key names) to unset optional fields like 'fingerprint' rather than sending an empty string.
After updating IPAM config, apply the pending SDN configuration via put_cluster_sdn_reload so changes take effect cluster-wide.
The 'lock-token' param is only needed if another SDN operation holds a global config lock; normal updates can omit it.
